list.title: Branches
list.description: The gym's branches. Each branch's code (B1, B2…) is part of receipt numbers and never changes.
list.choose: Choose a branch from the list.

errors.nameRequired: Write the branch name in Kurdish.
errors.name: This name is too long.
errors.phone: This phone number is not valid. Use digits and spaces only.

detail.newDescription: The branch gets its code by itself (B2, B3…).
detail.allBranchesOnly: Only someone with access to all branches can add or change branches.
detail.notFound: This branch wasn't found, or you can't see it.
detail.deactivateDescription: This branch's devices stop working until it is reactivated, or they are moved to another branch. Nothing is deleted.
detail.reactivateDescription: The branch and its devices work again.
